purpose: Timed, same-scenario benchmark plan for agent-crew and reference AI harnesses.

scenarios.title: First project handoff
scenarios.objective: Install or refresh, initialize a repository, run the first read-only task, and produce visible task state.
agent_crew_commands: crew run "Summarize repository architecture and record evidence."

scenarios.title: Small implementation with verification
scenarios.objective: Run one scoped code or docs change with explicit verification and a durable result artifact.
agent_crew_commands: crew run "Make a scoped documentation or fixture change and verify it."

scenarios.title: Approval, recovery, and audit trail
scenarios.objective: Exercise a guarded operation, preserve approval evidence, recover a host handoff if needed, and prove what happened from local state.
agent_crew_commands: crew run "Perform a guarded local workflow and record audit evidence."

scoring.completion_latency: lower is better for equal task scope
scoring.evidence_completeness: higher is better; count durable files and explicit pass/fail signals
scoring.recovery_clarity: higher is better; score whether a new operator can resume from printed state

non_goals: Do not install or execute third-party harnesses in an unapproved environment.
Do not compare unrelated task scopes.
Do not treat marketing claims as measured runtime evidence.
